summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.87/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.87 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 23, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 3¢ higher than a week ago, 14¢ higher than a month ago, and 92¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.58) and the highest in Superior ($4.25).
